transcript.content: Hello, I am Dr. Smith. To get us started, could you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?

I'm here because I've been struggling with eating really huge amounts of food in a short period of time. It feels like I completely lose control during these times, and I just can't seem to stop myself once I start.
After these episodes of overeating, do you engage in any behaviors to try to prevent weight gain, such as self-induced vomiting, excessive exercise, or the misuse of laxatives?
No, I don't do any of those things to try and prevent weight gain. I've never forced myself to throw up, used laxatives, or tried to exercise it off afterward.

latest_inference.note: Previously, the candidates were [Binge-Eating Disorder, Bulimia Nervosa]. The patient explicitly denied compensatory behaviors such as self-induced vomiting, laxative misuse, or excessive exercise, which are diagnostic criteria for Bulimia Nervosa. Therefore, Bulimia Nervosa has been ruled out, leaving Binge-Eating Disorder as the sole candidate.
